newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Details of Russian ADR issues and plans.
newsitem.headline: Details of Russian ADR issues and plans.

text.p: The following are details of depositary receipts already issued by Russian companies or planned in the future
(Source Reuters, Bank of New York, Salomon Brothers):
LAUNCHED TsUM TZUM.RTS - July 3, 1997. American Depositary Receipts. Level-1. One ADR covers 20 ordinary shares.
UES EESR.RTS - May 12, 1997. Global Depositary Receipt (GDR). Regulation S. One GDR covers 100 ordinary shares. The GDRs will trade on London SEAQ and shortly on Berlin Stock Exchange.

LUKoil pref LKOH_p.RTS - Feb 12, 1997. American Depositary Receipts. Level-1. One ADR covers two underlying preferred shares. Irkutskenergo IRGZ.RTS - Jan 23, 1997. American Depositary Receipt. Level-1. One ADR covers 50 underlying shares.
RICs
Bank Menatep - Q1, 1997, American Depositary Receipt. Level-1 Surgutneftegaz SNGS.RTS - Dec 30, 1996. American Depositary Receipt. Level-1. One ADR covers 50 ordinary shares.
RICs
Tatneft TATN.RTS - Nov 29, 1996. Private placement of 10 percent of company capital or 2.33 million shares at $45 a share. American Depositary Receipts. 144A, Regulation S.
Overallotment brought total offer to 2.7 million ADR. One ADR covers one share.
June 3, 1996. American Depositary Receipts. Level-1.
RICs.
Gazprom GAZP.RTS - Oct 24, 1996. American Depositary Shares. 144A, Regulation S. One ADS covers 10 underlying shares. Raised $430 million on 27.3 million shares.
RICs and O#GAZPq.L. Vimpelcom VIPM.RTS - Nov 20, 1996. American Depositary Receipts. Level-3. (ADRs issued before shares traded in Russia)

PLANNED
Aeroflot - planning level-one ADR
Avtovaz - planning ADR, but no details yet
Babayevskoye - plans level-one ADRs on 10 percent of capital in 1997
Chernogorneft CHGZ.RTS - considering issuing a level-three ADR to be listed on New York Stock Exchange
Gazprom GAZP.RTS - plans another international issue after April 1997

Inkombank - plans level-two ADRs in 1997 LUKoil LKOH.RTS - plans 15 percent stake of government-owned stock to non-strategic investors in form of level-three ADRs in 1997 or Q1 1998. Also plans level-one GDRs on underlying ordinary shares listing in London
Megionneftegaz MFGS.RTS - planning level-one ADR Mosenergo MSNG.RTS - plans level-one ADR in 1997. Exemption received in November 1996, documents sent at end of April 1997.
Salomon Bros says level-three ADRs also planned Neftekhimbank - planning ADR
Nizhny Novgorod Svyazinform - planning ADR
Nizhny Tagilsk steel - plans level-one or 144-A ADRs in November
Norilsk Nickel NKEL.RTS - plans level-one ADRs, dependent on financial stabilisation.
Purneftegaz PFGS.RTS - was planning level-one ADR but announced end of April 1997 it dropped plans because of planned unified Rosneft share
Rostelekom RTKM.RTS - says level-two ADR programme is 99 percent ready, just needs board approval.
Samara Svyazinform - planning ADR
Sidanko - planning ADRs (probably level-one) in early 1998
Surgutneftegaz SNGS_p.RTS - plans level-one ADRs on preferred shares
Sverdlovenergo SVER.RTS - plans to convert up to 26 percent of shares held by foreign ivestors to level-one ADRs by end of 1997
Tatneft TATN.RTS - mulling level-three ADR issue since announced plans on Sept 25 1996. Accounts for 1994 and 1995 audited to international standards, waiting for 1996 results.

Bankers said could be just trying to raise capital through private placement of ADR or level-two issue Tyumentelekom - plans to issue level-one ADRs on ordinary and preferred shares in September 1997. Also considering a level three ADR programme in the future.
UES EESR.RTS - ADRs planned in summer 1997.
Uralmash - ADRs planned by end 1997 or early 1998 in a $30-35 million private placement of new shares which would convert to level one ADRs
Uralsvyazinform URSI.RTS - planning level-one ADR issue 1997 YUKOS - planning level-one ADRs
